inlines.v: UNGRA'CIOUS, adjective 1. Wicked; odious; hateful. 2. Offensive; unpleasing; as ungracious manners. 3. Unacceptable; not well received; not favored. Any thing of grace towards the Irish rebels was as ungracious at Oxford as at London.
